targets.requiredResult: The protected journal sink returns an HMAC-authenticated proof bound to the exact canonical receipt record, journal entry and read-back head.
SQLite rejects a projected status transition unless the exact proof fields are present and match the durable receipt row.
Every acknowledgement monotonically anchors the proven journal head in SQLite and preserves the complete proof.

Before pending projection or new archive authorization, the runtime verifies that the SQLite-anchored journal head still exists at the exact sequence and fails closed after rollback to an older internally valid complete tail.
Real SQLite and protected-file tests reject forged proof fields, proof reuse for another receipt, valid complete-tail rollback, and restart with an unverifiable anchor.
